scope_discipline.rule: A lane whose specified input is absent must say so and must not silently substitute a different corpus as if it were the same object.
scope_discipline.applied: The 400-case table is absent; the 10-case bench is analysed instead and is labelled as a different, smaller object everywhere it appears.

post_outcome_changes_forbidden: changing the ternary encoding after seeing which reduct it produces
dropping a coordinate from the feature set after seeing the reduct
presenting the 10-case result as the 400-case study

claims_under_test: Target-sufficiency holds iff the coordinate set hits every opposite-target discernibility set.
On the committed 10-case bench, k* = 3 with core {known_composition, prior_art_found}.
Binarising prior_art_found (merging null into false) destroys sufficiency entirely.
explicitly_not_claimed: anything about the 400-case corpus, whose data is absent
that the validity/applicability/transfer/utility coordinates are unnecessary - the bench does not test them
novelty over donor rough-set / discernibility theory

independent_checker_requirements.independence_rule: No ORION-14 module imported. Bench read as data; reduct recomputed from the discernibility definition.
independent_checker_requirements.scope_gate_rule: the absence of the 400-case table must be ASSERTED by search, never assumed
independent_checker_requirements.cannot_check_rule: exit code 3, status CANNOT_CHECK, never reported as a pass

stop_rule: Complete for the committed corpus. Executing Upgrade A as specified requires committing the 400-row table; that is an artifact task, not a science task, and it is NOT a submission blocker for ORION-14.
